rules.name: Duplicate calls
rules.description: The same provider, method, and request hash repeated within the short window after a successful response.

rules.name: Missing cache
rules.description: An identical GET or documented deterministic POST repeated after the short window and within the long window following a successful response.

rules.name: Retry storms
rules.description: Identical calls retried too quickly after non-success responses, forming a chain of multiple attempts.

rules.name: Oversized payloads
rules.description: Requests or responses larger than the configured size limit, which usually means more data is being sent or fetched than needed.

rules.name: Unbatched calls
rules.description: Bursts of separate calls to an endpoint that has a documented batch alternative.

rules.name: Token bloat
rules.description: The same long conversation context sent again and again at full input price. Experimental.

rules.name: Model overuse
rules.description: A premium model used for small tasks where its cheaper sibling may do. Experimental.
